workersInvalid: Concurrency must be an integer greater than 0
workersSaved: Saved the number of concurrent work agents (applies to tasks started later)
noaOn: noa context compaction enabled (applies to runs started later)
noaOff: noa context compaction disabled (built-in compaction restored)
title: System settings
subtitle: Global runtime switches
trafficDesc1: When on, all agents' HTTP traffic is recorded in full through the recording proxy, and agents are given the traffic_search / traffic_get tools and the proxy configuration (the prompt includes a proxy note).
trafficDesc2: Off (default): no traffic is recorded. Agents are not given the proxy configuration or traffic tools, and the prompt contains no proxy-related content. Switching takes effect immediately by rebuilding the agents.
trafficOnState: On · recording traffic and injecting the proxy
trafficOffState: Off · not recording, no proxy injected
bindingDesc1: Off by default. When on, the report agent triggered when a finding is saved checks existing HTTP requests/responses and links the matching traffic before writing the report. Reading packets and making extra tool calls increases token usage.
bindingDesc2: Reporting still works normally for TCP, uncaptured traffic, or when no traffic matches. This switch does not affect traffic capture, manual binding or viewing saved evidence. Applies from the next round of the agent; turning it off immediately rejects new automatic bindings.
globalProxyDesc1: All agents' target traffic egresses through this proxy (hides the source IP / goes via a jump host). Supports http / https / socks5, and may include user:pass authentication. Leave blank for a direct connection.
globalProxyDesc2: With traffic capture on, it serves as the upstream of the recording proxy (traffic is still fully recorded, then egresses through this proxy). With capture off, it is injected directly into the agents' bash / WebFetch egress. It is independent of the web-search proxy and the LLM proxy.
globalProxyDesc3: Note: with capture off, socks5 depends on each command-line tool's support for ALL_PROXY (curl works, some tools may ignore it). If you mainly use socks5, enable traffic capture instead: this path has MITM dial out itself, so tools are unaware and it works reliably.
globalProxyOn: Configured · all target traffic egresses through this proxy
globalProxyOff: Not configured · target traffic connects directly
injectDesc1: When on, each task's operation constraints (the allow/deny entries maintained under "Operation constraints" in the task overview) are added to the matching agent's system prompt, to frame the exploration boundary (e.g. "only test the current port", "no brute forcing").
injectDesc2: You can control injection into the planner and the worker separately; both are on by default. Changes take effect immediately (read on the next round) without rebuilding agents. When off, that agent no longer sees the constraints.
expDesc1: Mechanisms still under validation, off by default. They may change agent behavior or affect stability; enable only once you understand the impact.
expDesc2: noa context compaction: the model actively compacts long conversation history (norma v0.4.0). When on, the four agent types on the platform (planner / worker / main agent / chat) use noa to manage context instead of the built-in compaction. Original compacted text is archived in the task working directory for later review. Takes effect immediately (applies to runs started later) without rebuilding agents; turning it off restores the built-in compaction right away.
searchDesc1: This is the master switch and source configuration for web search. It must be on before you can choose whether to enable web_search in each agent's configuration (returns titles, links and snippets only, no page bodies; WebFetch handles fetching). Web search does not go through the recording proxy and is independent of traffic capture.
searchDesc2: Sources: DuckDuckGo (ddgs) (no key needed), Brave (free tier) (requires a Brave API key), Tavily (requires a Tavily API key), or DeepSeek (reuses the current LLM configuration). When the master switch is off, the per-agent web search toggles are unavailable.
searchOnState: Master switch on · can be enabled per agent
searchOffState: Off · agents cannot enable web search
dsP1: This source reuses the currently active LLM configuration directly. Therefore it only supports official DeepSeek models, and that configuration must use the anthropic protocol. DeepSeek's OpenAI-protocol endpoint does not support server-side search. This source may stop working after you switch the LLM configuration.
dsP2: Unlike other sources, the search is executed by the DeepSeek server: each search consumes one extra model call (incurring token charges), search requests do not go through the egress proxy above and are not recorded in traffic logs, and results contain only titles and links (no snippets). WebFetch retrieves page bodies when needed.
dsP3: You are responsible for confirming the conditions above are met; the system does not block anything. Use the "Test search" button below to run a real search and verify.
braveNeedsKey: Brave is selected but no key is configured. The search tool stays disabled until a key is saved.
tavilyNeedsKey: Tavily is selected but no key is configured. The search tool stays disabled until a key is saved.
braveFree: The free tier allows about 2,000 queries per month. Get a key at https://brave.com/search/api/.
tavilyGet: Sign up at https://tavily.com to get an API key.
proxyHelp: A separate egress proxy used only to reach the search endpoints (VPN / SOCKS, etc.). Unrelated to the MITM proxy that records traffic; use it when the network can't reach the endpoints directly.
testHint: Runs one real search for "test" with the current configuration (source + proxy + key) to verify it works.
pyDesc: Custom script-type tools use this to run Python. It is detected automatically at startup (python3 preferred); you can enter an absolute path here, such as a venv or a specific version, or leave it blank to auto-detect at runtime.
workersDesc: Number of work agents running concurrently per task (default 3). Higher values probe more in parallel and cost more. Changes apply to tasks started later; running tasks are not affected.
keyboardDesc1: The main agent input box on the chat page and the task detail page share this setting. It takes effect immediately after you choose, with no save needed.
keyboardDesc2: This preference is stored only in this browser and is not synced with your account. You'll need to set it again if you switch browsers or clear site data.
